items.html: And now we shall explain how, through this ibbur, the broken vessels were corrected. It was already explained above that the main cause of the breaking of these vessels was that dross and shells were mixed into them, and the lights did not connect with their vessels because of the dross in them, and the vessels themselves also could not receive the lights because of the dross in them, for this itself was the reason that these vessels did not emerge from the outset bound and corrected by way of lines, since the dross in them caused their separation. And it was also written above that all this was with the intention that the dross would separate from them, and therefore they came out without correction.
